description: An MEG dataset recorded while participants viewed colored square wave spiral gratings and the color words "blue" and "green". Eight spiral gratings (pink, blue, green, and orange, each in light and dark variants) subtended 10 degrees of visual angle, and the words appeared in white on a gray background. Each stimulus was presented for 116 ms, and event triggers identify the stimulus category. The data are suited to studying neural representations of color and color words.
methods_description: MEG data were recorded while participants viewed eight square wave spiral gratings subtending 10 degrees of visual angle and the color words "blue" and "green" in white on a gray background. Each stimulus was displayed for 116 ms, with event IDs 1-10 marking the stimulus identity (1-8 spiral gratings: light/dark pink, blue, green, orange; 9 "green"; 10 "blue").
